name: Prediction-market risk-on regime gate on crypto trend (pm_risk_on arms momentum)
rationale: Thesis: Polymarket-derived pm_risk_on (BOUNDED 0-1) prices the macro/event risk regime BEFORE it appears in any single crypto's own price — a forward-looking, cross-asset risk-on/off tag NOT derived from crypto price, so it cannot be the same momentum in disguise. Plain crypto trend is exhausted; here trend is only ARMED when the leading risk regime supports risk-taking. Enter LONG a major when trend is confirmed (ret_Nd>0 AND adx above a fitted floor) AND pm_risk_on is above a fitted risk-on level, AND fear_greed is NOT in extreme greed (avoid buying a euphoric top — a two-source regime confirm pairing the leading odds tag with the crowd gauge). Exit when the leading signal flips risk-off (pm_risk_on cross_down its threshold) or trend fails (ret_Nd<0). Regime shifts are infrequent so the position is regime-held — LOW turnover, fee-friendly. Disconfirmers: (1) the same trend with NO pm_risk_on gate (disc-momentum-only control) — the gated spec must beat it; (2) gate the same trend with a NON-CAUSAL control (weather_hub_stress) instead of pm_risk_on — the pm gate must beat spurious gating; (3) lead-lag check that pm_risk_on is not merely lagging crypto price. If neither control is beaten, the edge is just trend/buy-the-dip and this FAILs honestly. The Gate disposes.
catalyst: prediction-market odds flip risk-on (pm_risk_on above fitted level) while crypto trend is confirmed and the crowd is not euphoric
